description: Create a pending signup record. This does NOT open a PRActicle Roth IRA or any other account and does NOT email the user. Those IRA products are waitlist-only and are not open to consumers. Agents can help a person join https://gigaverse.ai/ira-waitlist. They cannot open an account. Returns a signup_url (signup id only, no secret) that the HUMAN account owner must open. They confirm with a one-time code emailed to them when they start that page, or while signed in as that email. partner_id is required and must already be an approved partner. Approval is in Mission Control (https://mc.trydragonfly.com). Idempotent per email.

partner_id.description: Approved partner attribution slug (from register_partner, after approval)

sandbox.description: true = test mode: nothing is stored, no email is sent, and the returned signup auto-progresses through the full lifecycle for testing

name: start_signup
